Name: Craftable Mushroom Boxes
Author: foggywizard
Description:
Makes the vanilla mushroom boxes craftable and moveable! Earn 40k gold and 3 hearts of friendship with Demetrius and he'll send you a letter with the recipe!
Change the recipe if you don't like it by changing the items used and the amount of them!

[b]Note: The code that makes mushroom boxes moveable will not work on preexisting mushroom boxes. This is not something I can fix because it's due to an item's code getting baked into the item upon creation. Try something that resets your farm cave to be able to move already placed boxes.

[/b]To whomever added the Portuguese tag: I have rejected it because there are only partial translations for the current version. Same with the previously supported Korean and Chinese versions. Once there are complete translations I will add those tags

Downloads.Description: Tentative multiplayer fix. Added Thai translations.
